title: where do i have design system files ? all in one file or sep

messages.content: where do i have design system files ? all in one file or separate ?

Your design system is **split across 4 separate files** in `design/`, not one file. Each has a distinct job:

| File | Role |
|---|---|
| `design/tokens.css` | **Source of truth** — CSS variables (colors, spacing, etc.). Never hard-code; reference this. |
| `design/Styles.txt` | Plain-text reference of the same values (for quick lookup / pasting into Bubble). |
| `design/design.md` | The **rules and reasoning** — why tokens are what they are, section structure, conventions. |
| `design/CRS_UI_Kit.html` | Rendered UI kit / visual component reference. |

There's also a brain pointer at `brain/design.md`, but it's just a redirect — it says the real source lives in `design/tokens.css` + `design/design.md`, so it never duplicates them.

**Rule of thumb:** change a value → edit `design/tokens.css` (and mirror in `Styles.txt`); change a rule/rationale → edit `design/design.md`.
write me prompt for buildprnt to provide latest data about design system

Here's a copy-paste prompt for the Buildprint chat. It's **read-only** (sync + report, no `apply`) — its job is to pull the current Bubble styles so you can reconcile them against `design/tokens.css`.

```
Read-only task — do NOT apply, check, or edit anything. TEST branch only.

1. Run `buildprint sync` first to pull the latest snapshot.
2. Read the styles/ folder in the shredded worktree and report the app's
   design system as it currently exists in Bubble. I want the ACTUAL values,
   not a summary. Cover:
   - Color variables / app colors (name → hex, incl. any opacity variants)
   - Font/text styles (name, font family, size, weight, line-height, color)
   - Element styles (buttons, inputs, groups, etc.) and their key properties
   - App fonts loaded (uploaded/Google) and default font
   - Any spacing / border-radius / shadow tokens defined as styles
3. Present it as a plain table grouped by category, exact values.
4. Flag anything that looks inconsistent or duplicated (e.g. two greys, an
   unnamed style, hardcoded colors not tied to a variable).

Do not change files. Do not run apply. Just report.
```

Two things to know before you run it:

- **What "design system" maps to in Bubble** = the `styles/` folder in the shredded tree (color variables, font styles, element styles) — not `design/tokens.css`. Bubble is the as-built source; your repo files are the intended spec. This prompt tells you what Bubble *actually* has so you can spot drift.
- **After it reports**, if you want I can diff its output against `design/tokens.css` + `design/Styles.txt` and list the mismatches, then we decide which side is authoritative before any edit.

Want me to also draft the follow-up *apply* prompt (to push repo tokens into Bubble), or keep it read-only for now?
